notes: One stakeholder contradicts themselves. Tests conflicts within a single speaker as well as across speakers.
input:
Owner: Customers order on our website and pay online only — no cash, too much hassle. Delivery within 5 km. Also, half our regulars are older folks who always pay cash on delivery, so we must keep that. Orders open 11am–11pm.
Kitchen manager: We close the kitchen at 10pm, last orders must be 9:30.
Owner: Our own staff deliver. Also we should list on the big delivery apps so their drivers handle it.

conflicts: online payment only vs keep cash on delivery
orders open until 11pm vs last orders at 9:30pm
own staff deliver vs delivery app drivers
mustNotInvent: a named delivery app stated as explicit
